products.details: Bixolon SRP-275III 3” serial dot-matrix receipt printer suited to a range of applications, from kitchen printing, to end-of-day reporting, customer receipting, service reports and can produce simultaneous multiple copies. Featuring an ergonomic easy clean design and easy print paper loading, the SRP-275III has the option of either Tear-Bar or Auto-cutter. Boasting three interface options including USB V2.0 FS + Serial + Ethernet*, USB V2.0 FS + Parallel or USB V2.0 FS + Serial (*DHCP enabled). Offering Intelligent Logic Seeking and Bi-Directional Print Technology, the SRP-275III is fast and quiet and has the ability to print multiple copies with reliability of up to 18 million lines. Alongside a Virtual Memory Switch Manager (VMSM) allowing the printer settings and the default language to be changed easily. Additionally, it is an excellent choice for parcel weighing and logistics purposes. The scale features adjustable LED tilt displays on both the front and side, ensuring clear visibility of weight measurements. However, for enhanced convenience, a remote LED dual pole display is also available as an optional accessory. One of the key advantages of the PDN scale is its ability to connect with popular POS software such as Samtouch and ICRtouch, allowing seamless integration into existing systems. Moreover, the PDN scale offers the flexibility to install it into a counter, creating a flush surface that blends seamlessly with the surroundings. This setup enables the pole display to be placed elsewhere for easy customer viewing, enhancing the overall user experience. Download Datasheet

products.name: HONEYWELL MK3780 SCANNER USB BLACK WITH STAND
products.description: HONEYWELL MK3780 SCANNER USB BLACK WITH STAND
products.details: Honeywell’s FusionTM 3780 is an affordable hand-held omnidirectional laser scanner with single-line capability that increases retail checkout system efficiency with its automatic in-stand operation, optionally integrated EAS, and industry-leading scan performance. Fusion combines omnidirectional and single-line laser bar code scanning into a lightweight, ergonomic hand-held form factor. The 20-line scan pattern provides superior scanning over existing single- line hand-held scanners making Fusion ideal for medium-volume retailers including specialty stores, pharmacies, liquor stores, and convenience stores. An adjustable stand with 50° of tilt and three locking positions provides flexibility for the user to position the scanner for individual comfort and optimal performance. Stabilized with a weighted metal base, the stand may also be hard-mounted to counters or walls. Fusion also includes CodeGate®, a Honeywell patented feature used in the highly successful Voyager® series. An integrated infra-red (IR) sensor automatically activates the laser when a bar code is present. The user then properly aligns the bar code before pressing the button, transmitting the data to the host. This feature provides the ability to pass over other bar codes, selecting only the required code. No other scanner offers this much control. Standard features such as Flash ROM, MetroSelect® and MetroSet®2 programming, and user replaceable cables protect your investment by enabling Fusion to grow with you and your application requirements. products.name: HONEYWELL MS1200G SCANNER FEMALE BLACK
products.details: Built on the platform of the world’s best-selling single-line laser scanner, Honeywell’s Voyager® 1200g delivers aggressive scan performance on virtually all linear bar codes, including poor quality and damaged codes. Updated object detection, and automatic in-stand detection and configuration enable class-leading presentation scanning that maximizes throughput. Superior scan performance matched with a reliable design combine to provide a versatile linear scanning solution suitable for a wide variety of applications. The intuitive Voyager 1200g provides fast and reliable scanning of linear bar codes across its full working range, minimizing the need for user training. Whether poorly printed, smudged or faded, the Voyager 1200g decodes difficult-to-read bar codes with ease. The Voyager 1200g also excels at scanning high density bar codes with resolution down to 3.5 mil, eliminating the need to purchase specialty scanners. Designed to decrease downtime and service costs, the Voyager 1200g includes a single shock-mounted PCB that delivers greater impact resistance. A recessed button protected by an integrated rubber co- mold minimizes the impact of accidental drops. Added durability is provided in the form of a protected, scratch-resistant glass window and an IP42-rating. The Voyager 1200g, the next installment in the world-renowned Voyager series, provides outstanding scan performance and reliability for end users seeking an exceptional linear scanning solution. products.details: Honeywell’s Eclipse 5145TM is a low cost laser-based alternative to CCD scanners. Its compact form factor and high end feature set simplify its use in a variety of applications at the press of a button. Eclipse is a single-line, hand-held laser scanner. Equipped with Honeywell’s patented CodeGate® technology, Eclipse can be used in a wide variety of applications. CodeGate® technology allows the user to easily target the desired bar code and complete data transmission with the press of a single button. This makes Eclipse a perfect selection for menu scanning, point-of-sale, document processing and inventory control. With Honeywell’s state-of-the-art scanning technology, the Eclipse 5145 has a longer working range and a wider scan field than a typical CCD. The width of the scan line grows as the scanner moves further away from bar codes. CodeSense® is a unique feature employed by Eclipse in the absence of infrared object detection. It provides the user with a pulsing laser line for bar code detection. When a bar code is detected, the laser line switches to a constant state to allow for scanning via CodeGate®. With its easy-to-install design, you can effortlessly mount your EFT devices onto the upstanding of the iMin Crane IDS stands, creating a streamlined and efficient checkout experience for your customers. The bracket is constructed with high-quality materials to ensure durability and stability. Its sleek and compact design complements the overall aesthetics of the iMin Crane IDS, enhancing the visual appeal of your point of sale area. With the iMin Crane EFT Bracket, you have the flexibility to choose the perfect stand configuration for your specific business needs. Whether you opt for the tabletop or floor stand, this universal bracket seamlessly integrates with both options. This means you can effortlessly change or upgrade your stand configuration without having to invest in additional brackets. In summary, the iMin Crane EFT Bracket is an essential accessory for businesses in various industries. Its universal fit, versatile compatibility, and sleek design make it an ideal choice for those seeking a convenient and efficient solution to integrate EFT devices with their iMin Crane IDS.

products.name: IMIN FALCON 2 - 5" SECONDARY DISPLAY
products.details: The iMin Falcon 2 offers an optional 5-inch secondary display designed to enhance customer interactions and streamline business operations. This auxiliary screen is particularly useful for: Showcasing Promotional Materials: Display advertisements or special offers to engage customers during transactions. Capturing Digital Signatures: Facilitate electronic signature collection for transactions requiring customer authorization. Assisting in Ordering Processes: Provide customers with a clear view of their orders, enhancing transparency and reducing errors. The secondary display integrates seamlessly with the Falcon 2's modular design, connecting via pogo pins to ensure a stable and reliable attachment. This integration allows businesses to maintain a clean and organized countertop while enhancing the overall customer experience.

products.name: IMIN FALCON 2 80MM PRINTER DOCK GRAY
products.details: The iMin Falcon 2's 80mm Printer Dock is a high-speed thermal printing accessory designed to enhance the device's point-of-sale capabilities. This dock integrates seamlessly with the Falcon 2 through its magnetic base, providing a stable and efficient solution for businesses that require rapid and reliable receipt printing. Key Features: High-Speed Thermal Printer: Equipped with a Seiko thermal printer that supports 80mm paper width and an 80mm diameter paper roll. The printer features an automatic cutter and offers a printing speed of up to 250mm/s, ensuring quick transaction processing. Enhanced Connectivity: The 80mm Printer Dock expands the Falcon 2's connectivity options with additional ports: DC Jack x 1 USB Type-A x 2 RJ12 x 1 RJ45 x 1 Pogo pin (9-pin) connector By incorporating the 80mm Printer Dock, businesses can streamline their operations, reduce countertop clutter, and improve transaction efficiency, making it an ideal choice for high-volume retail and hospitality environments.

products.details: iMin Heron 1 Self-Service Kiosk The iMin Heron 1 is a powerful all-in-one self-service kiosk designed to improve customer flow, reduce queue times, and free up staff for higher-value tasks. With a sleek modern design, large Full HD display, powerful AI-enhanced octa-core processor, versatile mounting options, and multiple accessory choices, Heron 1 is built for demanding retail, hospitality, and service environments. High-Performance Processing At the heart of the Heron 1 is an advanced 8-core processor featuring dual-core A76 2.0GHz and hexa-core A55 1.8GHz architecture, supported by an NPU rated at 3 TOPS. Large Full HD Touch Display The 23.8" 1920 x 1080 Full HD display delivers crisp visuals and excellent screen space for menus, promotions, check-in interfaces and payment prompts. The multi-point capacitive touch panel supports 10-point touch, works even with gloves or wet hands, features anti-fingerprint treatment, and uses durable G+G glass construction. Scanner Options to Suit Your Business Heron 1 can be configured with different scanner options depending on your environment. The standard scanner is designed for everyday barcode and QR code reading, while the retail scanner offers improved performance, faster scanning, better depth of field, and support for MRZ scanning, including passport reading. Standard Scanner 0.3MP CMOS sensor 30 FPS scanning speed QR code depth of field: 13mm–230mm (40mil) Accuracy: 1D ≥ 5mil, 2D ≥ 6mil EAN13 depth of field: 13mm–120mm Retail Scanner 1.3MP CMOS sensor 60 FPS scanning speed QR code depth of field: 0mm–280mm (40mil) Accuracy: 1D ≥ 4mil, 2D ≥ 5mil EAN13 depth of field: 0mm–170mm MRZ scanning support for passports Flexible Payment Support Heron 1 is designed to support modern payment environments, including NFC payments with SoftPOS compatibility, EMV payment workflows, and QR code payments. This makes it a strong option for businesses looking to streamline ordering and payment in one kiosk platform. Additional Features 2MP front camera Facial recognition capability Dual 3W speakers Dual microphone system HDMI connectivity for additional displays Automated start-up for simplified deployment Dust- and water-resistant front interface Removable front cover for easier cleaning and maintenance Magnetic stripe reader option for loyalty or staff identification use Mounting & Accessory Options Heron 1 is built to adapt to different installation needs, with support for floor stand, table stand and VESA/wall mounting options. Available accessories include: MSR card reader Status light POS holder Payment module holder NFC module Scanner Integrated printer Technical Specifications Processor: Octa-core (Dual-core A76 2.0GHz + Hexa-core A55 1.8GHz), NPU 3 TOPS Memory: 4GB RAM + 64GB ROM / 8GB RAM + 128GB ROM / 16GB RAM + 256GB ROM Display: 23.8", 1920 x 1080 Full HD Viewing Angle: ±85° (H) / ±85° (V) Brightness: 250 nits Contrast Ratio: 1200:1 Touch Panel: Multi-point capacitive touch Operating System: Android 15, 64-bit Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6, Ethernet 1000M, Bluetooth 5.4, NFC Camera: 2MP front camera Speaker: Dual 3W speakers Operating Temperature: 0°C to 50°C Storage Temperature: -20°C to 60°C Printer: 80mm thermal printer with automatic cutter, up to 250mm/s Scanner: Supports 1D barcode and 2D QR scanning Power Adapter: Input 100–240V / Output 24V / 2.5A Ports USB 2.0 Type-A x 1 USB 3.0 Type-A x 4 USB 2.0 Type-C x 1 3.5mm headphone jack x 1 DC jack x 1 HDMI x 1 RJ11 x 1 RJ12 x 1 RJ45 x 1 Pogo pin (6 pin) x 2 DB9 x 2 TF card slot (up to 1TB) x 1 Certifications Google GMS, FCC, CE, IMDA and WEEE. products.name: SAM4S ELLIX 40SB THERMAL PRINTER BLACK
products.description: The Sam4s Ellix 40 is a high-performance thermal receipt printer designed for retail, hospitality, and ticketing environments where speed, reliability, and flexibility are essential.
products.details: The Sam4s Ellix 40 is a high-performance thermal receipt printer designed for retail, hospitality, and ticketing environments where speed, reliability, and flexibility are essential. Fast & Efficient Printing Capable of printing at speeds of up to 300mm per second , the Ellix 40 ensures rapid transaction times, reducing queues and improving customer service. Compact & User-Friendly With its drop-in paper loading system , operators can replace paper rolls quickly and easily, minimising downtime at busy checkout counters. Versatile Connectivity The Ellix 40 comes equipped with USB, Serial, and Ethernet interfaces as standard , offering excellent flexibility for integration with any POS system. Durable & Reliable Built with a high-quality auto-cutter rated at 1.5 million cuts and a print head life of 150km , the Ellix 40 delivers dependable long-term performance in demanding retail and hospitality environments. Stylish & Practical Design Its modern, compact footprint makes it suitable for even the tightest counter spaces, while still maintaining easy access to all connections and controls. Key Features & Benefits High-speed printing at 300mm/sec for fast transactions Supports both 80mm and 58mm paper widths Triple interface (USB, Serial, Ethernet) for maximum compatibility Drop-in paper loading for easy maintenance Reliable auto-cutter with long service life Compact, space-saving design Ideal for retail, hospitality, and ticketing application Specifications Printing Method: Direct Thermal Printing Speed: Up to 300 mm/sec Print Width: 80mm (standard) / 58mm (with paper guide) Resolution: 180 dpi x 180 dpi Paper Roll: Max Ø80mm, drop-in loading Interfaces: USB + Serial + Ethernet (triple interface as standard) Cash Drawer Port: 1 (RJ11) Cutter: Auto-cutter (guillotine type, 1.5 million cuts) Reliability: 150 km print head life Power Supply: External adaptor Dimensions: Approx. 145(W) x 195(D) x 148(H) mm Weight: 1.3kg

products.details: Sam4s ER-180UL Cash Register The Sam4s ER-180UL is a compact, reliable cash register ideal for small retail and hospitality businesses . Designed with user-friendliness and efficiency in mind, it delivers all the essential features required for smooth day-to-day operations. This operator-friendly model provides complete sales analysis by department, function, and drawer totals. Cashiers can easily issue customer receipts or journal tapes , depending on store requirements. The built-in thermal printer delivers fast, silent, high-quality printing and can be configured for either receipt or journal mode. You can also add your business name and details to every receipt, creating a professional and personalised customer experience. The ER-180UL now comes standard with a large customer display and memory capacity for up to 500 PLUs (Price Look-Ups) , allowing efficient control and tracking of your most popular products. Key Features • 5 Sales Departments • 500 PLUs (Price Look-Ups) • 10 Clerk Logins • 4 Programmable Tax Rates • Standard Lockable Cash Drawer • Single-Station Thermal Printer (Receipt or Journal) • Large Customer Display (standard) • Secure Mode & Calculator Mode • Auto Date Change • Full End-of-Day Reporting Dimensions: 400(W) x 201(H) x 450(D) mm Weight: 8.2 kg Benefits • Ideal for small retail shops, cafés, and hospitality counters • Quiet, fast, and reliable thermal printing • Easy to program and operate • Compact, robust design to fit any counter space • Professional-looking custom receipts Download Datasheet

products.details: A truly user-friendly entry-level cash register from SAM4S. Ideal for any small retail or hospitality environment, the ER-260 is easy to set-up and use and offers 15 departments and 1,000 product look-ups – more than enough for small restaurants, mobile catering businesses and takeaways. Thermal receipt printing is fast and quiet, and the receipt can be customised with graphics if required. Features Power Type 230V, 50hZ. Voltage 230V Warranty 1 Year Colour Black 15 Sales departments 10 cashier IDs 8 coin and 4 note compartments 1000 Price look ups VAT calculation Electronic journal Financial and sales reporting Euro compatible The Sam4s ER-260BEJ is a budget priced electronic cash register that is big on performance and ideal for all kinds of retail, catering and hospitality outlets The fast, quiet thermal receipt printer comes with an auto-load feature to stop the frustrating and time consuming paper jams problems experienced with some cash registers. The SAM4S ER-260 also comes with a “Receipt on Demand” function that allows the operator to print receipt on request, this features saves paper and reduces receipt litter around checkout areas. To further save paper the journal/ audit roll is stored in electronic format internally in the machine and can be printed on request. With 15 department keys and 1,000 PLU’s (Price Look Ups), two line operator display and standard cash drawer specification the Sam4s ER-260BEJ is capable of meeting the requirements of any small to medium retail or catering outlet. A range of daily and periodic reports are available using the secure X or Z key modes. Key Features Easy set-up & operator friendly. Single station thermal printer. Graphic logo. Auto paper load. Calculator mode. 15 Programmable departments. 1000 PLU’s (Price look up’s). Automatic VAT calculation. Large Cash Drawer 8 coin 4 notes. products.name: SAM4S ER920 CASH REGISTER
products.details: Sam4s ER-920 Cash Register – Reliable, Feature-Rich, and Easy to Operate The Sam4s ER-920 is a high-performance cash register designed for retail and hospitality businesses that require reliability, functionality, and simplicity. Combining a durable build with advanced features, it’s ideal for cafés, pubs, restaurants, convenience stores, and general retail operations. With its flat keyboard , single-station thermal printer , and large operator display , the ER-920 provides a user-friendly experience while offering all the essential functions needed for daily sales management. Efficient and User-Friendly Design The ER-920 is designed for ease of use, with a large flat keyboard suited for fast-paced environments such as hospitality and takeaway service. The bright LCD operator display ensures clear transaction visibility, while the silent thermal printer produces fast and professional receipts. Comprehensive Functionality This register offers advanced features including PLU (Price Look-Up) management , department tracking , cashier control , and report generation , giving businesses full control over sales and performance data. The ER-920 can be used as a standalone system or integrated with peripherals such as barcode scanners, kitchen printers, and POS terminals, making it adaptable for growing businesses. Reliable and Secure Equipped with a robust metal cash drawer and secure key-lock functions , the Sam4s ER-920 provides both physical and operational security. Its solid construction ensures long-term reliability in high-traffic environments. Specifications Feature Specification Model Sam4s ER-920 Printer Type Single-station thermal printer Paper Width 57mm Keyboard Type Flat keyboard (ideal for hospitality use) Display Operator: LCD / Customer: Pop-up display PLUs (Price Look-Ups) Up to 2,000 PLUs Departments 99 Clerks/Operators 10 Tax Tables 4 Reports X, Z, Financial, PLU, Clerk, Department reports Interfaces 1 x RS232 (for scanner or printer connection) Cash Drawer 8 coin / 4 note compartments Locking Mechanism 3-position key lock Paper Loading Easy drop-in paper loading Dimensions (W x D x H) 400 x 450 x 265 mm Weight 8.2 kg Power Supply AC 230V / 50Hz Colour Black Applications Retail, Hospitality, Takeaway, Café, General Stores Why Choose the Sam4s ER-920 The Sam4s ER-920 offers the perfect balance between traditional cash register simplicity and modern functionality . With its robust design, advanced reporting features, and flexible configuration, it’s the ideal choice for small to medium businesses looking for a dependable and affordable EPOS solution . products.name: SAM4S ER920 CASH REGISTER GRADED
products.details: The ER-900 series of ECR’s are designed with a bright alphanumeric display along with a range of keyboard designs including raised or flat for all Hospitality and Retail situations. The ER-900 series also has Single (Receipt) or Twin Station (Receipt & Journal) thermal printer(s) plus numerous features such as Scanning and Check Tracking to Overlapping Cashiers ensure the register is suitable for all environments. Thermal Printer(s) & Keyboard Types Choose a single printer or traditional receipt and journal model. Both provide fast, quiet thermal printing. Drop-in loading simplifies paper changing and virtually eliminates paper jamming. Receipt & Journal Printer (Models; ER-940, ER-945) Use a two-printer model when a customer receipt and a traditional real-time printed journal is needed for sales archival. Single Printer Models (Models; ER-920, ER-925) The single printer models are best for receipt only or journal only applications. If you choose a single printer model for printing receipts, you can record your journal electronically in the register’s memory. Electronic Journal If a receipt and a sales journal is needed, the journal can be archived electronically for printing at end of day, can be collected on an SD card, or can be polled and collected by a PC. A variety of electronic journal reports are available that allow you to quickly audit selected activities. Keyboard (For Retail) The traditional raised key keyboard provides 56 keyboard PLU keys and can be decreased by your Sam4s dealer to 21 PLU keys. Keyboard PLU’s act like traditional departments for open priced entries or can be set as preset price keys. Large key size provides easy-to-read key labels. Keyboard (For Hospitality) With 150 key locations, the flat keyboard can easily accommodate large menus with preset keys for each item. Where menus change daily with breakfast, lunch or dinner times the paper key-sheet under the overlay is easily exchanged. Up to 10,000 PLU’s. Up to 99 Group Totals. Up to 50 Clerks/Cashiers. Mix & Match (Promotions). Quick Help Function in ‘REG’ Mode. Graphic Bitmap Logo with 20 Pre-Loaded. Condensed Journal. Automatic Tax Computation for up to 4 Rates or Tables. 10 Media Keys: Cash, Check and up to 8 Charge Keys. Compulsory Cash Declaration. Add Check Function. Not Found PLU – with Easy Creation. 10 One-Touch Macro Keys. Training Mode. Cancel Sale Function. Keylock Controlled Transaction Void. Clerk Name Display. Price Inclusive Barcodes. Post Tendering. 4 Automatic Currency Conversion Keys. Management Reports Complete Financial Report. Individual Clerk/Cashier Report. Hourly Sales Analysis. Reporting for up to 50 Clerks/Cashiers. PLU By Price Level Reporting. Period-To-Date Financial, Hourly, Cashier, Group and PLU Reports. Sales by Day Report for 31 Days. Open Check Report. Download Datasheet

products.name: SAM4S ER945 CASH REGISTER
products.description: SAM4S ER945 Cash Register. Raised Keyboard. Twin Station Printer
products.details: The ER-900 series of ECR’s are designed with a bright alphanumeric display along with a range of keyboard designs including raised or flat for all Hospitality and Retail situations. The ER-900 series also has Single (Receipt) or Twin Station (Receipt & Journal) thermal printer(s) plus numerous features such as Scanning and Check Tracking to Overlapping Cashiers ensure the register is suitable for all environments. Thermal Printer(s) & Keyboard Types Choose a single printer or traditional receipt and journal model. Both provide fast, quiet thermal printing. Drop-in loading simplifies paper changing and virtually eliminates paper jamming. Receipt & Journal Printer (Models; ER-940, ER-945) Use a two-printer model when a customer receipt and a traditional real-time printed journal is needed for sales archival. Single Printer Models (Models; ER-920, ER-925) The single printer models are best for receipt only or journal only applications. If you choose a single printer model for printing receipts, you can record your journal electronically in the register’s memory. Electronic Journal If a receipt and a sales journal is needed, the journal can be archived electronically for printing at end of day, can be collected on an SD card, or can be polled and collected by a PC. A variety of electronic journal reports are available that allow you to quickly audit selected activities. Keyboard (For Retail) The traditional raised key keyboard provides 56 keyboard PLU keys and can be decreased by your Sam4s dealer to 21 PLU keys. Keyboard PLU’s act like traditional departments for open priced entries or can be set as preset price keys. Large key size provides easy-to-read key labels. Keyboard (For Hospitality) With 150 key locations, the flat keyboard can easily accommodate large menus with preset keys for each item. Where menus change daily with breakfast, lunch or dinner times the paper key-sheet under the overlay is easily exchanged. Up to 10,000 PLU’s. Up to 99 Group Totals. Up to 50 Clerks/Cashiers. Mix & Match (Promotions). Quick Help Function in ‘REG’ Mode. Graphic Bitmap Logo with 20 Pre-Loaded. Condensed Journal. Automatic Tax Computation for up to 4 Rates or Tables. 10 Media Keys: Cash, Check and up to 8 Charge Keys. Compulsory Cash Declaration. Add Check Function. Not Found PLU – with Easy Creation. 10 One-Touch Macro Keys. Training Mode. Cancel Sale Function. Keylock Controlled Transaction Void. Clerk Name Display. Price Inclusive Barcodes. Post Tendering. 4 Automatic Currency Conversion Keys. Management Reports Complete Financial Report. Individual Clerk/Cashier Report. Hourly Sales Analysis. Reporting for up to 50 Clerks/Cashiers. PLU By Price Level Reporting. Period-To-Date Financial, Hourly, Cashier, Group and PLU Reports. Sales by Day Report for 31 Days. Open Check Report. Download Datasheet

products.description: The SAM4S HCUBE is a compact thermal receipt printer designed for high-speed, reliable performance in retail and hospitality settings.
products.details: SAM4S H-Cube Black Thermal POS Printer The Sam4s H-Cube Black is a high-performance, stylish thermal receipt printer designed for retail, hospitality, and ticketing environments. Combining exceptional print speeds with robust reliability, it delivers smooth and efficient transaction processing in even the busiest settings. With ultra-fast printing up to 400mm per second , the H-Cube minimises waiting times and boosts customer satisfaction. Its drop-in paper loading system ensures quick and hassle-free roll changes, while the auto-cutter guarantees clean, precise cuts every time. With its spill proof multi-touch bezelless display, ergonomic design and innovative base, the Sam4s Titan S560 is one of the most stylish and aesthetically pleasing point of sale terminals in its class. With either traditional stand or VESA options for wall & pole mount provides greater flexibility of installation. The Sam4s Titan S560 Touch Screen is supplied with an external power adaptor for ease of replacement. A reliable & accessible system the Sam4s Titan PC POS terminal has many added benefits making it excellent value for money & a great investment as your POS equipment. products.name: ZEBRA LI4278 USB BT BLACK SCANNER
products.description: The Zebra LI4278 is a cordless handheld 1D barcode scanner designed to enhance productivity across various industries, including retail, healthcare, and warehousing.
products.details: The Zebra LI4278 is a cordless handheld 1D barcode scanner designed to enhance productivity across various industries, including retail, healthcare, and warehousing. Its Bluetooth capabilities provide the flexibility to capture virtually any 1D barcode, whether printed on paper labels or displayed on electronic devices. Key Features: Superior Scanning Performance: The LI4278 captures virtually all 1D barcodes, including high-density codes commonly used in electronic component manufacturing. It reads UPC barcodes from 1 inch (2.54 cm) to over 30 inches (76.2 cm) away, and 200% UPC codes at 55 inches (139.7 cm). The scanner's wide working range and ability to capture barcodes at extreme angles reduce the need for precise positioning, enhancing user efficiency. Cordless Freedom with Bluetooth Connectivity: Equipped with Bluetooth v2.1 with Enhanced Data Rate (EDR), the LI4278 offers secure wireless communication and improved energy efficiency. It provides a working range of up to 100 meters (328 feet) in open spaces, allowing users to move freely without being tethered by cables. Extended Battery Life: The scanner features a rechargeable, replaceable battery designed for continuous use, supporting up to 57,000 scans per full charge. This extended battery life ensures reliable operation throughout the workday. Durable Design: Built to withstand everyday use, the LI4278 endures multiple drops from 1.8 meters (6 feet) onto concrete and is sealed against dust and moisture, ensuring dependable performance in various environments. Specifications: Dimensions: 6.48 in. H x 2.75 in. W x 3.84 in. D (16.5 cm H x 7 cm W x 9.7 cm D) Weight: 7.76 oz. (220 g) Connectivity: Bluetooth v2.1 with EDR; interfaces include USB, RS-232, RS-485 (IBM 46xx), and Keyboard Wedge Battery: Rechargeable Li-Ion battery Operating Temperature: 32° to 122° F (0° to 50° C) Drop Specification: Withstands multiple drops from 6 ft. (1.8 m) onto concrete Decode Capability: 1D barcodes, including UPC/EAN, Code 39, Code 128, and more The Zebra LI4278 is engineered to enhance operational efficiency with its rapid scanning capabilities, cordless design, and robust construction, making it a versatile solution for various barcode scanning applications.
